stock.description: Green Energy Group Limited, an investment holding enterprise, conducts diverse business operations. The company is actively involved in the global trade of recyclable oil and biodiesel, with its reach extending to markets like Hong Kong, Europe, Malaysia, Singapore, and Japan. Its multifaceted activities are organized across several key divisions, including the provision of waste construction materials and processing services, renewable energy initiatives, plastic and metal scrap recycling, money lending, and healthcare. Beyond its core energy and recycling ventures, the group also deals in waste construction materials and processes various waste and plastic items, alongside trading in metal scrap. Additionally, it offers and arranges credit financing, manages a portfolio of freehold land, and provides a suite of healthcare services encompassing body check-ups, immunizations, general medical care, and pharmaceutical sales. The company's corporate headquarters are located in Hong Kong.
